verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any testing utilities, mock or fake model classes, or guidance for unit-testing agents with stubbed models and tools. Custom Tool subclassing and support for any LLM are developer building blocks a user could adapt into mocks, not a documented unit-testing capability. The axis applies to an agent framework, so the lack of evidence makes this none.

support.subject: As a developer, I can unit-test agents with mocked models and tools
